summary: Harden the test-only eval grader against empirically observed false negatives by normalizing token syntax, accepting versioned evidence-backed semantic aliases, tolerating string/array result forms, and pooling descriptive invariant fields while keeping selected_action field-strict and forbidden meanings fail-closed. New synonym equivalence remains judgement unless added explicitly from empirical evidence or review.

requirements.rationale: The change improves assurance fidelity for existing contracts; it adds no new project requirement.

issues_findings.rationale: The first empirical five-case eval round exposed deterministic grader false negatives caused by exact-token and result-shape variance; this slice addresses that observed harness defect.

risks.rationale: The grader must not turn plausible syntax differences into false failure claims or relax forbidden semantic states into false completion.

decisions_concepts.rationale: Token equivalence remains test-harness configuration under tests/evals and does not become a new project concept or semantic ontology.

derived_views.rationale: The current reconciliation pointer must identify this material assurance change; no new canonical source is introduced.

active_work.rationale: Existing real trial outputs become regression inputs before expanding the trial matrix. The deterministic alias map does not replace repeated fresh-model trials or human review of genuinely ambiguous outputs.
